analysis: APP surged 7.9% to close at $356.10, outpacing the market by 12.4 percentage points on a day when the S&P 500 fell 4.4%. The headlines uniformly attribute the move to third-quarter results and outlook that beat expectations, with coverage reporting the stock jumped following the earnings release and noting increased cash generation backing a larger buyback. The company reported yesterday after the close, beating estimates by 6.7%, and the session's 31.0% rise included an abnormal move of 38.3 percentage points beyond what the market alone would explain — the largest reaction in the recent history shown, far above the typical 12.2 percentage point abnormal move around its reports. While APP has beaten estimates in all eight recent quarters, two of those beats were followed by negative abnormal moves, so outperformance hasn't always led to gains; this time the response was unusually strong.
